issues.title: Alibaba: the only registered annual original has a null market projection, so filing-fetch refuses every reuse route
issues.background: The package expects an Alibaba input from the audited annual filing. company-wiki holds exactly one Alibaba-W annual original (HKEX FY2026, document sha256 e39fbf9c..., 4,172,424 bytes, published 2026-06-18); its source_query candidate is capture_ready=true with published_date set but market=null.
issues.intent: Obtain a capture-ready handle through scripts/source_preparation.py -> filing-fetch -> company-wiki, then build the schema 3.7 input and submit the job.
issues.observed: filing-fetch hard-binds candidate.market to the verified identity market. Six routes were refused: exact/reuse_only -> 'company-wiki source query market mismatch'; exact/fetch_if_missing -> 'operation market mismatch'; FY2025/reuse_only -> source_blocked local_metadata_gap (blocks_download=true); latest_as_of/reuse_only and latest_as_of/fetch_if_missing -> 'ensure blocked: local_metadata_incomplete'; US 20-F/fetch_if_missing -> 'ensure exited 1' (provider_failed, adapter dayu-us-sdk discover exited 1, zero HTTP exchanges). Every route reported downloads=0.
issues.impact: Alibaba cannot be built or submitted. This is not a budget, network or identity problem: identity resolution succeeds and company-wiki's own ensure returns reused_existing for the same document.
issues.recommendation: 1) CWP owner repairs the market projection for document e39fbf9c... (the provider sidecar carries market=HK, so the projection is what is lost); 2) FF owner allows a null candidate market to fall back to the verified identity market and records market_source=identity_fallback; 3) restore the dayu-us-sdk adapter so the 20-F route works. Acceptance: any route returns status=found with capture_ready=true and a non-null market.
issues.my_next_step: build the Alibaba variant of build_mdb_input.py and run the same input -> job -> report chain

issues.title: MongoDB: the newest audited annual (FY2026 10-K) is stored but not capture-ready, so the base year fell back to FY2025
issues.background: company-wiki holds companies/MongoDB, Inc/raw/.../10-K 2026-01-31.htm (2,218,293 bytes) whose sidecar has filing_date and market, but the source_query candidate reports capture_ready=false, published_date=null and https_url=null.
issues.intent: Use FY2026 (ended 2026-01-31) as the base year for the most recent audited numbers.
issues.observed: filing-fetch rejected the handle with 'handle published_date must use YYYY-MM-DD format' (the value is null, not malformed). The FY2025 10-K in the dayu_portfolio root (sha256 b3788068...) is fully capture-ready and was used instead.
issues.impact: The base year is FY2025 (2,006.443 US$m), one year behind the information date; this is disclosed in management_communication_coverage.latest_annual_filing and in the report limitations.
issues.recommendation: CWP records the missing publication date and market through its managed source-facts path; FF separates 'field missing' from 'format invalid' into two named error codes.
issues.my_next_step: re-run with the FY2026 original once it becomes capture-ready

issues.title: Catalog admission is outside the job facade and needs a different records protocol, so section 5.4 is not met
issues.background: The package requires registering the report so Dashboard can read it with list-reports.
issues.intent: Register the succeeded job's report in the managed catalog with its report id and result_sha256.
issues.observed: import-research-attempt / import-research-publication only read a B34 trusted research-admission package under <owner-root>/delivery/<run_id> (run.json, execution/{scope,step-ledger,budget-observation,terminal,deployment-update-ff-reviewed}.json, execution/requests/, recorder events, native compute/validate/snapshot captures, an independent review receipt and the operator's recorder SHA). The rf-job/1 facade produces a job store instead. list-reports exits 2 with owner_root_missing.
issues.impact: The report is consumable only by commit path plus tracked artifact copies, not through the catalog read CLI.
issues.recommendation: 1) owner/D00 defines an admission adapter that maps facade job records into the admission package while labelling the executor as the facade (no invented recorder events); or 2) exposes a lightweight registration interface accepting result_sha256 + independent review receipt + input hash; until then the handoff carries tracked copies and key hashes.
issues.my_next_step: run import-research-attempt then import-research-publication and verify with list-reports once the protocol exists

issues.title: deployment.company_wiki_config semantics differ from the name: it must be the filing-fetch config

issues.intent: Point it at the company-wiki configuration.

issues.title: The job store sits under a gitignored artifacts/ path, so job artifacts were outside the commit
issues.severity: P1 in the first review round
issues.background: The owner root must live inside the repository and the facade writes to <root>/artifacts/rf_jobs/.
issues.intent: Deliver the job artifacts so a consumer can bind a fixed commit.
issues.observed: The repository .gitignore excludes artifacts/, so result.json / report.md / registry lines were absent from the commit (git cat-file failed); the independent reviewer raised it as P1.
issues.impact: Commit-based consumption would have found nothing.
issues.recommendation: The facade should export a bundle (or default the job store to a non-ignored path) and expose a ready-to-commit artifact list in the JobView.
issues.my_next_step: none; copies plus manifest are committed and hash-verified

issues.title: The publication audit succeeds silently, leaving a zero-byte artifact
issues.background: The facade freezes the publication stage stdout as stages/publication/audit.json.
issues.intent: Keep an audit record for the publication stage.
issues.observed: publication_registry.py audit prints nothing on success, so audit.json is 0 bytes (e3b0c442... is the empty-string hash).
issues.impact: A reader can mistake an empty file for a failed or unimplemented stage.
issues.recommendation: Print one JSON line on success (result_sha256, registry line hash, validation_status, registry path).

issues.title: The input capture and the job source-stage capture are two real reads of the same bytes
issues.background: The input must exist before the job can be submitted, and the facade runs its source stage as a separate process.
issues.intent: Bind the input to a verified source while letting the facade re-verify the source in its own stage.
issues.observed: Same source_id and snapshot_sha256 (b3788068...) but different receipt_sha256 (525ce1ed... vs d528bd98...), because each read emits its own receipt.
issues.impact: Without context this looks like a receipt mismatch.
issues.recommendation: Let forecast_input declare the snapshot expected from the source stage and have the facade verify it, or freeze the source-stage envelope into the input.

issues.title: Two different result hashes identify the same forecast
issues.background: The engine records result_sha256 and revenue_backtest.py create records forecast_result_sha256.
issues.intent: Freeze the delivered forecast through the module interface.
issues.observed: engine result_sha256=04768c27... hashes the payload without its own result_sha256 field; the snapshot's forecast_result_sha256=4587acc8... hashes the complete frozen dict. The frozen dict is identical to the delivered result.json.
issues.impact: Cross-checking one hash against the other reports a false mismatch.
issues.recommendation: Name them engine_result_sha256 and frozen_payload_sha256 in the schema, or record both in the snapshot.

issues.title: Hand-rendered table excerpts were not verbatim, which the review flagged
issues.background: The 10-K is HTML; text extraction splits table rows into one cell per line.
issues.intent: Cite the three disclosed revenue categories with a readable excerpt.
issues.observed: Two of fourteen excerpts were reading-order renderings rather than byte substrings (12/14 verbatim). v2 derives every excerpt as an exact slice of the checked text plus a fail-fast assertion, and the job was re-run (14/14 verbatim).
issues.impact: The first input was weaker evidence than it claimed; the delivered input is fixed.
issues.recommendation: Add a lint mode that requires each excerpt to occur in a declared checked-text snapshot, so an author cannot type it from memory.

issues.title: An out-of-band acquisition route was tempting but rejected on the module boundary rule
issues.background: With Alibaba blocked, the fastest fix was to download the SEC 20-F directly and register it through company-wiki official import.
issues.observed: Only the SEC submissions metadata index was queried (no filing bytes fetched, nothing written to the catalog); the route was stopped after the owner restated that modules own acquisition.
issues.impact: None on the artifacts; recorded so nobody repeats it.
issues.recommendation: Add a prohibited-route list to the package red lines (harness self-download, manual catalog writes, edits to other owners' repos) and prescribe the three-step handling: retry with supported parameters -> record the machine cause -> escalate to the owner.

issues.title: Baseline deviation: the package says published mainline HEAD, but main has no facade CLI

issues.intent: Base the work on the line that can actually execute the section 4 contract.
issues.observed: main (90c562ac) does not contain scripts/rf_job_cli.py or report_catalog_identity_cli.py; the facade branch tip d347c4ab does, and the delivered facade commit e4b38459 is its ancestor.

issues.title: The package's statement about the existing WuXi delivery does not match the disk
issues.status: not handled by this package, by owner instruction
issues.background: Section 0 says WuXi AppTec already has 3 runs / 4 validated reports from the B34/B37 rounds.
issues.intent: Record the observation so Dashboard does not look for reports that a commit cannot resolve.
issues.observed: On disk delivery/dashboard-b34-wuxi-20261101 has forecast v2 and 6 registry rows, delivery/dashboard-b37-wuxi-20261102 has v1-v3 and 9 registry rows, and both directories are untracked (git log --all -- delivery/... is empty), so no commit contains them.
